note: Pending host scenarios are not executed or counted as passing coverage. Bind the engine's real host interface before activating them. The standard does not prescribe invocation-option spellings.

scenarios.setup: Set m=4, resistance_alias=2000 and V(p,n)=1; request short and full operating-point reports.
scenarios.pending: An operating-point reporting interface. Internal values or metadata alone are insufficient.

scenarios.setup: Request model help separately for help_base and help_model.
scenarios.pending: A model-help interface.

scenarios.setup: Global pulse reject=20%, error=50%; specify paths enabled.
scenarios.pending: An invocation adapter for global pulse limits.

scenarios.setup: Enable negative timing checks. The oracle checks a gated violation, without prescribing internal delay calculation.
scenarios.pending: An invocation adapter for negative timing checks.

scenarios.setup: Observe the voltage equality residual's convergence tolerance.
scenarios.pending: A solver observer for equation tolerances; u_abstol describes unknowns and is not a substitute.

scenarios.setup: First obtain a documented finite limit and named diagnostic. Generate and compile identifiers of exactly that length and one character longer.
scenarios.pending: A documented finite limit and real compiler invocation adapter. No finite limit has been established for VerA; allocation exhaustion does not establish one.

scenarios.setup: Read 41 from input 41 73 during a trial iteration; reject it. Pair a healthy retry with a fault that prevents backing-position restoration and buffered replay.
scenarios.pending: Real host fault injection and observation of rejected iteration input restoration. A non-seekable but replayable stream is insufficient.

scenarios.setup: Bind one real opaque host driver to the opaque net; compare index 0 with the separate known behavioral-driver control.
scenarios.pending: A host driver whose type genuinely cannot be provided and an adapter documenting that applicability. Do not hide a known type to manufacture the condition.

scenarios.setup: Observe four pending absdelta events at a real tentative 12 ns solution before digital consumption. Compare accepting it with rejecting all its events and accepting clean 2 ns/4 ns retries.
scenarios.pending: A real mixed-signal host with pending-event and rejected-solution observers. The current conservative stepping interface does not expose this rejection state.

scenarios.setup: Evaluate the module and request its actual automatic output-variable report, including module values and excluding block-local attributed variables.
scenarios.pending: A real host output-variable reporting interface. Parsed metadata and internal values alone cannot establish automatic reporting.

scenarios.setup: Observe elaborated idt nature links including explicit self, default self, explicit parent and related override targets.
scenarios.pending: A real elaborated-nature-link observer.
scenarios.expect: Each listed nature's resolved idt_nature link equals its explicit self, default self, parent or related override target.

scenarios.setup: Observe elaborated ddt nature links including explicit self, default self, explicit parent and related override targets.
scenarios.pending: A real elaborated-nature-link observer.
scenarios.expect: Each listed nature's resolved ddt_nature link equals its explicit self, default self, parent or related override target.

scenarios.setup: Read retained max_voltage48 from elaborated discipline attributes.
scenarios.pending: A real elaborated-discipline observer.

scenarios.setup: Observe structural-only link final domain unknown and absent discipline.
scenarios.pending: A real final net-domain observer.
scenarios.expect: The structural-only net link resolves to domain unknown with no discipline.

scenarios.setup: Enumerate every live residual equation and check assigned tolerance and real gate decisions at zero, half and twice tolerance; reltol0.
scenarios.pending: A real solver equation inventory and residual-gate observer; unknown tolerances are insufficient.
scenarios.expect: Every live residual equation has a positive abstol and accepts residuals exactly at tolerance but not at twice it, both signs.

scenarios.setup: Observe actual accepted corners3/7/14/22ns, positive selected time tolerances for omitted and zero, and explicit1ps control without an output time grid.
scenarios.pending: A real transition breakpoint and accepted-step observer.
scenarios.expect: Omitted and zero time_tol place rising/falling corners at 3, 7, 14 and 22 ns within the effective tolerance; explicit 1 ps is honoured.

scenarios.setup: Observe rising and falling quarter/half/three-quarter levels under documented host defaults with no directive.
scenarios.pending: A documented finite positive host default and real transient observer.
scenarios.expect: Rising and falling transitions under the documented host default hit quarter, half and three-quarter values on schedule.

scenarios.setup: Actual transient derivative1V/s at3times and exact DC0; explicit Rate1u tolerance assigned to output with live half/twice gate decisions.
scenarios.pending: Real derivative-output tolerance observer.
scenarios.expect: ddt is 1 V/s at 0.1, 0.5 and 1.0 s and 0 in DC; its output gate accepts 0.5e-6 and rejects 2e-6 error.

scenarios.setup: Actual complex transfer1/0/1 at settled/active/settled transient states, with observed large-signal levels0/.3/1.
scenarios.pending: Real small-signal solves at frozen transient states.
scenarios.expect: The small-signal transfer is 1, 0, 1 at settled, actively slewing and settled states, against observed large-signal levels 0, 0.3, 1.

scenarios.setup: Compare the actual accepted analog trace against an identical run with the absdelta monitor structurally absent; allow ordinary adaptive steps and require four interior delta events.
scenarios.expect: See exact executable assertions and actual-observation schema in the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter exposing actual analog solutions and digital event delivery/provenance; unavailable instrumentation skips.

scenarios.setup: Compare the actual accepted analog trace with a structurally absent-monitor control; require one digital event at each changed accepted endpoint despite huge tolerances and no interpolated events.
scenarios.expect: See exact executable assertions and actual-observation schema in the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter exposing actual analog solutions and digital event delivery/provenance; unavailable instrumentation skips.

scenarios.setup: Requires genuine lookahead events and rejection of still-pending identities when a digital clamp causes a 4 ns analog solution.
scenarios.expect: See exact executable assertions and actual-observation schema in the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter exposing actual analog solutions and digital event delivery/provenance; unavailable instrumentation skips.

scenarios.setup: Observe a real pending cross event and its solution identity before acceptance/rejection; require fresh provenance on clean retry.
scenarios.expect: Actual observations as specified and asserted by the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter with kernel time and pending-event instrumentation. Unavailable states or instrumentation skip.

scenarios.setup: Observe actual digital time6ns when a5.2ns analog crossing is queued; enforce no delivery or enqueue before the current tick.
scenarios.expect: Actual observations as specified and asserted by the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter with kernel time and pending-event instrumentation. Unavailable states or instrumentation skip.

scenarios.setup: Observe both real kernel times and actual digital reads while analog is18ns and digital15ns; interpolate free1.5 but hold event-assigned1.0.
scenarios.expect: Actual observations as specified and asserted by the runner module.
scenarios.pending: A real host adapter with kernel time and pending-event instrumentation. Unavailable states or instrumentation skip.

scenarios.setup: Independent complete native capability introspection for the same host/configuration as the actual compiled macro probe; missing or unknown capability evidence is unavailable.

expect.macro_defined: iff every G.3 extension has actual supported status

scenarios.pending: Independent complete native capability introspection for the same host/configuration as the actual compiled macro probe; missing or unknown capability evidence is unavailable.

scenarios.setup: Trace successive Newton iterates of a nonlinear node and record each iteration's proposed node voltages and the per-node abstol.
scenarios.expect: For every iteration pair, |v(j)-v(j-1)| < reltol*max(|v(j)|,|v(j-1)|)+abstol, with reltol the host option returned by $simparam("reltol") and abstol the node tolerance.
scenarios.pending: A solver iteration trace exposing successive proposed solutions and per-node absolute tolerances; final-solution values or the reltol option alone are insufficient.

scenarios.setup: Run the fixture's multi-iteration cubic DC solve with a read descriptor opened before the solve and one $fgets per analog-block evaluation from a file of distinguishable lines. Observe what the evaluation after a rejected iteration reads: the clause resets the pointer to the position before the iterative solve started.

expect.rejected_iteration_read: the same line the rejected iteration read (the pointer was reset)
expect.accepted_solution_read: the read advances the position once per accepted solve

scenarios.pending: A solver that executes analog-block file reads inside rejected Newton iterations and exposes the resulting file position. VerA emits the §9.5.4 read calls only in the accepted per-point display pass (src/codegen/device/codegen/call.zig, gateOpen returns early for .file_read), so no read occurs during a rejected iteration and there is nothing to reset.

scenarios.setup: Run at least two Monte-Carlo trials over two instances of a paramset that draws the same seed with type_string "global", "instance", and omitted, and observe the per-instance parameter values.

expect.global: one value shared by both instances within a trial, redrawn per trial
expect.instance: a distinct value per instance within each trial
expect.omitted: the same scope as "global" (one value per trial)

scenarios.pending: A Monte-Carlo multi-trial host interface exposing per-instance parameter values. A single compilation is one trial with one instance, so the fixture can assert only acceptance and value stability (§9.13.2:4).

scenarios.setup: Call $sformat with a run-time-selected string-variable format holding one %d and two arguments (and again with fewer arguments than specifiers), capturing the simulation's warning diagnostics.

expect.warning: a run-time warning naming the argument-count mismatch
expect.destination: the formatted prefix is written and execution continues

scenarios.pending: A host interface that captures run-time warning diagnostics from a simulation. The fixture harness records only compile-time warnings (`//! warn`); an $sformat warning is written to the run's stderr and no runner asserts it.

scenarios.setup: Instrument the initialization sequence and record when module-level variable declaration assignments, analog initial blocks, analog net declaration assignments and simulator nodesets are applied.
scenarios.expect: Variable declaration assignments precede analog initial execution; analog net declaration assignments and nodeset values are applied only after all analog initial blocks have executed.
scenarios.pending: An initialization-phase order trace from the host. The final DC solution and the constant nodeset values are order-independent, so a numeric transcript or metadata read cannot establish the sequence.

scenarios.setup: Expose the three pre-opened standard file descriptors and their numeric values as the simulator represents them.
scenarios.pending: A host interface exposing the pre-opened descriptor constants. The fixture language cannot query their values; the fixture pins only that a fresh $fopen channel is not one of them.

scenarios.setup: Trace every call the simulator makes to the user limiter mylim in $limit(V(p,n), mylim, 0.7) and record the three actual arguments and the return.

expect.arg2: the internal state, generally the previous $limit return

scenarios.pending: A host callback trace of the user limiter. An identity limiter fixes the converged return whatever the simulator passed, so a transcript cannot observe the actuals.

scenarios.setup: Pass one two-dimensional array as the $table_model data source instead of the separate one-dimensional column arrays.
scenarios.expect: The same table is captured and interpolated as the equivalent columns; the snapshot uses the array as written.
scenarios.pending: VerA's table-model lowerer accepts only one-dimensional array sources (src/analog/lower/table_model.zig, E0815); a production change is required before a fixture can assert the single two-dimensional array form.
